name: Parallel Coordinates with Dimensionality Reduction
definition: A user interface using Parallel Coordinates (PCs) where each volumetric attribute is an axis and the specified value is a control point, combined with dimensionality reduction methods for global data investigation.
summary: Parallel Coordinates with Dimensionality Reduction maps volumetric attributes to axes and uses algorithms like LLE to project high-dimensional data into 2D space, enabling global investigation of multivariate volume visualization.
